chunks: We have kept account of everything in a book.

key_terms.أَحْصَيْنَاهُ: We have enumerated/kept account of it

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God has counted everything in a book?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Kitab Mubin* (the Clear Book), which some scholars identify with the preserved tablet of divine knowledge or the collective record of the Imams' teachings. It underscores the precision of Divine Decree (*Al-Qada wa Al-Qadar*), affirming that no atom's weight in the universe escapes God's meticulous enumeration, thereby validating the eventual resurrection and accounting of deeds.
